reponse: No 40% discount was ever approved. Sam's approval limit is 15% on a 2-year term and 10% max on a 1-year, with 40% described as a no regardless of seat count [2]. The quote sent to Mark was for 140 seats on a 2-year term at a 12% discount, and Mark was told 40% isn't possible [3]. Company policy caps approval at 10% for an AE and 20% with CEO sign-off, with anything above 20% not allowed in FY26 [4]. Mark's request for 180 seats at 40% off list, or a fall back to 120 seats, is still pending procurement's answer, with a call scheduled with Jenna to settle the seat count [1][3]. Also note the seat dispute: 140 active users versus the 180 in the draft [5].
